name: go-binary-size
description: > Reduce the size of compiled Go binaries and container images: linker flags, inlining budget, CGO and build tags, embedded assets, dependency weight, and measuring what actually costs bytes. Use when a binary or image is too large, when shrinking a CLI for distribution, or when auditing what a dependency adds to the build. Trigger examples: "binary is too big", "shrink the binary", "reduce image size", "strip symbols", "what is making my binary large", "ldflags -s -w". Not for: runtime speed an
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 帮助分析并缩小 Go 编译产物和容器镜像，适合二进制过大、精简 CLI 或审查依赖体积来源的场景。
